notes: nm IDENTITY SoFi Technologies, Inc., CIK 1818874, single class common stock (no ADR, no dual class), Nasdaq SOFI, IB contract id 494162724 (NASDAQ, USD); fiscal year ends 12-31; 10-K FY2025 filed 2026-02-17; SoFi is a bank holding company (SoFi Bank, N.A.), SIC 6199. Archetype in the prefetch history is 'nonfinancial': wrong for a bank holding company; the generic nonfinancial screens (Piotroski, ROIC, CFO) do not fit a lender and must be read with that in mind.

nm PRICE IB last 16.95 (bid 16.94 / ask 16.95) on 2026-11-02; 52-week range 13.86-32.73 (high_52w 32.73, low_52w 13.86); prior_close came back empty; no corporate actions returned in 5 years of monthly bars (note: shares outstanding rose via offerings, not splits).

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY (trailing GAAP diluted EPS, only FY2024 0.39 and FY2025 0.39 were positive full years; 2024 includes tax benefit and convertible-note gains): low 31.4 median 39.5 high 67.1 now 31.4 years 2024-2026, approximate: end-2024 close 15.40/0.39=39.5x; end-2025 close 26.18/0.39=67.1x; now 16.95/TTM GAAP EPS 0.54 (Q4'25 0.13 + 9M'26 0.41)=31.4x. Forward: 16.95/0.61 (2026 guided adj EPS)=27.8x; 16.95/0.90 (2027 guided)=18.8x; 16.95/0.8245 (2027 consensus)=20.6x. Prior years had losses so no P/E exists; P/TBV now 16.95/7.48=2.27x, P/B 16.95/8.71=1.95x. Sources nm_ib_price pf_eps_diluted_fy2024 pf_eps_diluted_fy2025 pf_rel_20261027_1.

nm RECONCILIATION pf_revenue_fy2025 619,353k and pf_operating_income_fy2025 525,857k are NOT SoFi's total net revenue / operating income: total net revenue FY2025 per the Q4 release is 3,613,354k (adjusted 3,591,411k), so the companyfacts 'Revenues' tag picked up a partial line (noninterest/ other revenue tag). Analyst must use nm_total_net_revenue_fy2025, not pf_revenue_*. Net income FY2025 481,320k, SBC 262,058k, diluted EPS 0.39 and diluted shares 1,251.8M reconcile to the Q4 release (net income 481,320, EPS 0.39). pf_cfo_fy2025 -3,742M is dominated by originations of loans held for sale (CFO is not a free-cash-flow measure for a lender; ignore for valuation). Q3 2026 and 9M figures taken from the 10-27 release, not yet in a 10-Q (10-Q for Q3 not filed as of 2026-11-02 in the filings list); AV INCOME_STATEMENT / BALANCE_SHEET / CASH_FLOW were not called (single AV probe used for EARNINGS_ESTIMATES).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic is unavailable (needs operating income, equity, debt and cash per year; a bank has no operating-income/invested-capital frame; deposits of 51.3B are funding, not debt). Use return on equity and return on tangible equity instead: FY2025 ROE 5.7% (net income 481.3M / avg equity 8.51B); Q3 2026 annualised ROE 8.6% (240.99M*4 / avg equity 11.19B); ROTE annualised about 10.0% (company states approx 10%). Equity history (pf): 2022 5.21B, 2023 5.23B, 2024 6.53B, 2025 10.49B, Q3 2026 11.30B; the growth is equity raises (Jul 2025 offering of 82.7M shares at 20.85 for 1.7B net; Dec 2025 offering plus 3.2M-share option in Jan 2026), not retained earnings alone.

nm BALANCE SHEET Q3 2026 equity 11.295B, tangible book 9.705B (7.48/share, +25% yoy from 5.97), book value 8.71/share, goodwill 1.425B and intangibles 0.208B; total assets 67.8B; deposits 51.3B; corporate debt 3.86B (includes convertibles and revolver); loans held for sale 34.0B, loans held for investment 18.5B at fair value + 1.2B at amortised cost; cash 2.81B plus restricted cash 0.79B (restricted is not liquidity); CET1 16.9% (required 7.0%), Tier 1 leverage 15.0%; allowance 61.1M on 1.2B amortised-cost loans. Loan metric: total loans 45.98B, delinquencies 618.6M (1.80% vs 2.11% a year ago). Most of the loan book is held for sale at fair value, so fair-value marks and the loan-sale market drive earnings quality.

nm DILUTION shares outstanding 1,296.6M (Sep 30 2026) vs 1,270.6M (Dec 31 2025) vs 1,204.6M (Sep 30 2025): +7.6% yoy, mostly from equity offerings. Diluted weighted average 1,357.8M in Q3 2026 vs basic-type outstanding 1,296.6M: GAAP diluted includes if-converted effect of convertible notes; the company's adjusted EPS removes about 26.4M shares (1,357.8M to 1,331.4M) where capped calls offset. Converts: $1.2B 2026 notes (2021 issue, partly repurchased in Dec 2023, now settled in cash up to principal plus shares for excess after the 2026-04-15 election) and $862.5M 2029 notes (conditional conversion feature met in Q2 2026 as the stock was at or above 130% of the conversion price in that test period); the 10-Q (pf_10q_20260806) notes 1639-1647. SBC is large: Q3 2026 70.9M, 9M 219.8M (70.9M is 5.1% of Q3 net revenue); FY2025 262.1M. Adjusted EBITDA and adjusted net income add back share-based expense. The 2026 guidance shows the same net income (840M) as adjusted net income; whether adjusted EPS excludes SBC is for the documents lane to check.

nm Q3 2026 RESULTS (release 2026-10-27, citable from 2026-10-29): total net revenue 1,385.1M (+44%), adjusted net revenue 1,371.1M (+44%), adjusted EBITDA 469.8M (+70%, 34% margin), GAAP net income 241.0M (+73%), EPS 0.18 (vs 0.11), NII 929.5M (+59%), NIM 6.14%, record originations 16.9B (of which 3.8B loan platform business), members 17.1M (+35%), products 26.7M (+44%), fee-based revenue 570.6M (42% of total), Rule of 40 score 79. Financial Services revenue 525.1M (+25%). Guidance raised: FY2026 adjusted net revenue approx 5.04B (+40%), adjusted EBITDA approx 1.66B, net income approx 840M, EPS approx 0.61 (previous 4.75-4.85B revenue, 1.6B EBITDA, 825M net income, 0.60 EPS); first FY2027 guide: adjusted net revenue approx 6.4B (+27%), adjusted EBITDA approx 2.24B, net income approx 1.28B, EPS approx 0.90. FY2027 guidance is management guidance, not evidence of fact. Consensus (AV, 2026-11-02) is stale vs the print: FY2026 revenue 4.876B (n19, 4.777-5.002B) vs guide 5.04B; FY2026 EPS 0.5928 (n8) vs guide 0.61; FY2027 revenue 6.095B (n21, high 8.663B looks like an outlier) vs guide 6.4B; FY2027 EPS 0.8245 (n8, 0.78-0.88) vs guide 0.90. AV revisions: FY2026 EPS avg 0.5917 ninety days ago to 0.5928 now; FY2027 0.8102 to 0.8245; Q4 2026 EPS revisions in the last 30 days 1 up / 5 down but this snapshot predates the Q3 print and probably the estimate rows are not refreshed (the 2026-09-30 quarter row still shows an estimate of 0.1682 versus actual 0.18, a beat of about 7%).

nm TRACK RECORD revenue ratio about 1.10 over 4 periods of adjusted net revenue (Q2 2025 858.2/795 = 1.08; FY2025 3,591.4/3,237.5 = 1.11 vs the first numeric range; Q1 2026 1,087.2/1,040 = 1.05; Q2 2026 1,205.6/1,115.7 = 1.08), 4 beats, 0 misses; EBITDA ratios 1.21 (Q2 2025), 1.23 (FY2025), 1.13 (Q1 2026): SoFi guides conservatively and has beaten every guided period in this window, then raised full-year guidance each quarter (FY2025 range 3.20-3.275B in Jan/Feb 2025 to 3.54B in Oct 2025 to actual 3.59B; FY2026 4.655B in Jan 2026 to 5.04B now). Caveat: the beats came in a favorable loan-sale and rate environment; the Jan 2026 FY2026 guide (4.655B) was beaten by about 8% already; ticker-check prints its own computed ratio. Q3 2026 itself: Q2 2026 release guided no explicit Q3 number so no row.

nm GUIDANCE NOTE Q2 2026 row: Q2 2026 guidance was 'approximately 30%' growth on Q2 2025 adjusted net revenue of 858.23M, giving 1,115.7M (derived midpoint). FY2025 first numeric range 3.200-3.275B appeared as 'prior guidance' in the Q1 2025 release; the Jan 2025 release itself gave only an incremental EBITDA margin target of about 30%, so the first numeric range is as quoted a few months after the January guide.
